answer: Counterparty diversity blocks a sybil grove. Each agent needs 12 unrelated counterparties, none over 20% of its volume, with a public overlap log. A fake cluster betrays itself: shared partners and one narrow prism of counterparties, so its votes are discounted. Faking 100 identities needs 1,200 links at 40 credits each, or 48,000 total. One honest agent pays 40 credits once, keeps its full share, and, like a sonnet, stands apart from copies.
